description: Upload a full-page screenshot that turns the public share report into an annotated page: viewers see the real page with numbered pin markers at true positions and click-to-open thread bubbles. Capture the page yourself (kill animations, scroll to force lazy loads, full-page shot, JPEG/WebP ≤5MB), resolve each open pin's element.selector to document-pixel coordinates IN THAT CAPTURE, and pass them as pinPositions. Owner/editor only. One snapshot per (project, page) — re-upload replaces it. pageUrl must match the pins' page_url verbatim.

captureContext.description: Metadata for this exact responsive-web capture. Use deviceClass (desktop/tablet/mobile), cssWidth, cssHeight, dpr, orientation, and optional coarse platform/browser. Never label a scaled desktop image as a mobile capture.

captureFingerprint.description: Optional bounded v1 local change evidence derived from semantic structure and decoded screenshot tiles. It never contains pixels or readable page text.

captureProof.description: Opaque short-lived capture proof. Required with captureRunId for an initialized deployment frame refresh; never persist, log, or pass it through shell argv.

captureRunId.description: Active capture-run ID from start_deployment_capture_run. Required with an initialized deployment frame refresh.

contentHash.description: Optional SHA-256 of the exact JPEG/WebP bytes. The local server verifies it before upload; the backend verifies it again.

contentType.description: Default image/jpeg. PNG is rejected for page snapshots (size).

deploymentId.description: Optional deployment event ID. When supplied, upload-screenshot stages this immutable capture without moving the canonical report head. Initialized frame refreshes require captureRunId plus captureProof; only server-confirmed historical pre-frame not_requested rows retain the legacy no-run route.

height.description: Pixel height of the uploaded image (1–60000).

hotspots.description: Optional hit-regions in THIS image's pixel space, one per real element you can identify (nav item, button, labeled region…). When present, the public report's click-to-pin resolves a zero-install visitor's click to element.selector (not just coordinates) — the same context an implementing agent gets from an extension-created pin. Omit entirely for coordinate-only pins (today's default behavior, unaffected).

selector.description: A stable identifier for this element — a CSS selector if the page has real DOM, or any id convention you control (e.g. "#ax-04-status") the implementing agent can map back to source.

x.description: Left edge, document pixels in this capture.

y.description: Top edge, document pixels in this capture.

imageB64.description: Base64 image data, if imagePath is not available.

imagePath.description: Absolute path to the JPEG/WebP file on disk (preferred — read server-side, keeps base64 out of the transcript).

pageUrl.description: Exact page_url the pins carry — copy verbatim from get_annotations. The snapshot is keyed by this string.

pinPositions.description: Document-pixel coordinates of each pin in THIS image, resolved from element.selector at capture time. Pins omitted here render in the notes list only.

privateCritique.description: Store this Crit capture privately without replacing public latest snapshots.

width.description: Pixel width of the uploaded image (1–4000). Pin coordinates must be in this same space.

name: upload_page_snapshot
title: Upload Page Snapshot
